Unknown route /does-not-exist-xyz renders branded 404 page.
critical_code_review_comments: OTP delivery path: when Resend email API returns 429 (rate-limited), /api/auth/request-otp raises HTTPException 502 even though the OTP has already been generated and stored in memory. Because the frontend depends on request-otp returning 200 to advance to the OTP-entry step, UI login is effectively blocked during upstream email throttling. Consider (a) returning 200 with a 'delivery may be delayed' notice while the OTP is still stored, or (b) surfacing a clearer client-side retry state — otherwise a legitimate user cannot log in when Resend rate-limits, even though the backend is healthy.
OTP_STORE is process-local in-memory dict; any restart or multi-worker deploy breaks verification. Acceptable for MVP but worth flagging for productionization.

receipt.pdf endpoint is unauthenticated by design and correctly excludes scores, but note that submission IDs are 8-char hex — an attacker could brute-force ~16.7M ids to enumerate portfolios' policy metadata (addresses, sums insured). Consider adding per-submission signed download tokens or rate limiting on /receipt.pdf.

Route mismatch worth documenting: App.js uses '/insights/submission/:id' (singular) while some code paths might use 'submissions' - the current wiring works but is inconsistent with the REST API path /api/submissions/{id}. Consider aligning to plural for readability.
